about: THE REFS GATES' FIXTURE (src/test/selftest_refs.cpp: refs-roundtrip, refs-activate, refs-npc-identity). The harness map's refs are never loaded by the game or a --shot (main.cpp). The file is in the canonical form refs::WriteGroup writes; refs-roundtrip asserts that byte for byte, so edit it with the References page or keep the one-ref-per-line shape. Rows are in author order, NOT id order, on purpose: activation must still run in id order.

refs.note: an unknown kind AND an unknown top-level field: both kept verbatim
